name: Daniel Romero
biography: Daniel is currently a security consultant and researcher at NCC Group. During his career he has worked in interesting security projects, always trying to “break” as much as possible. In the last years Daniel has mostly been focused on embedded devices / IoT and all what surrounds it such as hardware, code review, reverse engineering, fuzzing or exploiting. Twitter: @daniel_rome
